rows.disposition_reason: On Production, a blank name and a one-space name both draw Required under Name and leave port 5432. The space keeps the caret column of the one-character name. Ports 65536, abc, and 0 draw Port must… (U+2026). The validator in connections.rs returns Port must be 1–65535; reveal::fit clips that string in the port column at 120×40. Submit sets the status Fix the highlighted fields, leaves Edit connection open, and leaves Production in the tree. Connection saved is absent. The 120×40 checkpoint is that frame with a blank name, port 0, both drawn errors, host prod-db-1.acme.io, database acme_prod, and username acme_ops. At 80×24 the same form is a drawer, so the tree is covered. Name is blank with Required, the port is 0, and the port error is clipped to Port mus… (U+2026). The status Fix the highlighted fields is on the footer and Connection saved is absent. After the reopen shots, Ctrl+S with port 65535 saves. The detail shows Production, prod-db-1.acme.io:65535, Engine PostgreSQL, Environment production, and Safe Mode with deliberate acknowledgement. Opening Edit again shows name Production and port 65535.
rows.action_sequence: Create a connection. Enter a blank name, a whitespace name, an invalid port, and the implemented valid boundaries. Save.
